name: East India Company territory, c. 1805
name_hi: ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी का क्षेत्र, लगभग 1805
source: Hand-drawn approximation after Schwartzberg, A Historical Atlas of South Asia (1992), plate VII.A.2 (p. 55), 'The expansion of British power, 1766-1819'. One ring for the contiguous eastern block: the Bengal Presidency with Bihar, coastal Orissa (1803), Benares, the Ceded (1801) and Conquered (1803) Provinces up to Delhi, and the Madras Presidency with the Northern Circars, the Carnatic, Malabar, Kanara and the Ceded Districts. Awadh, Mysore, Travancore and Cochin are left as notches; Hyderabad, the Maratha states and the scattered Bombay and Gujarat holdings are omitted. Small allied states inside the outline (Coorg, Kurnool, Pudukkottai) are not cut out. Good first issue: trace properly from the DSAL scan.
